title: Right to Expedient Disposal of Complaint
description: The complaint shall be disposed of as expeditiously as possible

conditions: complaint does not require analysis or testing of commodities
complaint requires analysis or testing of commodities
exceptions: no adjournment shall ordinarily be granted by the District Commission unless sufficient cause is shown
the District Commission shall make such orders as to the costs occasioned by the adjournment as may be specified by regulations
the District Commission shall record in writing, the reasons for the same at the time of disposing of the said complaint
